description: Reply templates of the synthetic layer v1 (spec section b), in the register and length of the CRMArena-Pro customer emails (median about 820 characters). Slots in braces. Plain buyer language only: no rule, feature or outcome wording ever appears here (the leakage test scans this file). Template style is a known distinguishability risk (spec section b).
